author: Jack007x
quote: 0/10 – WHAT THE ACTUAL HELL IS THIS?!I’m sorry, but WHAT THE **** IS THIS SUPPOSED TO BE?! GTA 6? REALLY?! I’ve waited for this game like half the damn planet, and this is what we’re supposed to be excited about? This doesn’t even feel like GTA anymore. It’s like someone took everything that made GTA iconic, threw it into a blender, and then confidently served us the garbage.WHERE IS THE ACTUAL GTA FEEL?! Where’s the madness, the freedom, the chaos, the insanity, the personality?! What happened to the soul of this franchise? This is supposed to be the biggest gaming release of all time, not some confused identity crisis pretending to be a GTA game.I’m genuinely struggling to understand how something with the GTA name can feel this ridiculously disconnected from what GTA is supposed to be. At this point, calling it GTA 6 feels like false advertising to my expectations.I’ve never seen anticipation turn into disappointment this aggressively. Rockstar, WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?!0 STARS. ZERO. ABSOLUTELY **** ZERO. THIS IS NOT GTA. THIS IS A CRIME AGAINST THE GTA NAME.
